tasks.name: בלי האמצעי
tasks.note: Removes the element at index half the length, rounded down.

tasks.name: השני והשלישי
tasks.note: Keeps the second and third elements.

tasks.name: בלי הזוגי הראשון
tasks.note: Removes the first even element.

tasks.name: בלי כפולות 4
tasks.note: Removes the multiples of four.

tasks.name: בין 10 ל-13
tasks.note: Keeps elements from 10 to 13.

tasks.name: החלפת שני הראשונים
tasks.note: Swaps the first two elements.

tasks.name: חצי אחרון
tasks.note: Keeps the back half, including the middle element of an odd list.

tasks.name: השני לסוף
tasks.note: Moves the second element to the end.

tasks.name: מקומות זוגיים הפוכים
tasks.note: Keeps elements at even positions in reverse order.

tasks.name: סיבוב בשניים
tasks.note: Moves the first two elements to the end.

tasks.name: עד המקסימום
tasks.note: Keeps everything up to and including the largest element.

tasks.name: שני הגדולים בסדר
tasks.note: Keeps the two largest elements in their original order.

tasks.name: עם ביט 2
tasks.note: Keeps elements whose bit of value 2 is set.

tasks.name: שכן קרוב
tasks.note: Keeps elements that differ by exactly one from a neighbour.

tasks.name: מיון החצי הראשון
tasks.note: Sorts the front half ascending and leaves the rest as is.

tasks.name: ראשון ואז ממוין
tasks.note: Keeps the first element in place and sorts the rest ascending.

tasks.name: מיון שלושה ראשונים
tasks.note: Sorts the first three elements ascending and leaves the rest.

tasks.name: עד הזוגי הראשון
tasks.note: Keeps everything up to and including the first even element.

tasks.name: זנב זוגי
tasks.src: l=>{ let i=l.length; while(i>0&&l[i-1]%2===0) i--; return l.slice(i); }
tasks.note: Keeps the even elements at the end of the list after the last odd one.

tasks.name: עולה בדילוג של שניים
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(const x of l) if(!r.length||x>=r[r.length-1]+2) r.push(x); return r; }
tasks.note: Greedily keeps elements at least two above the last kept one.

tasks.name: גדול מלפני שניים
tasks.note: Keeps the first two elements and every element larger than the one two places before it.

tasks.name: המקסימום לראש בהחלפה
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; if(r.length){ const i=r.indexOf(Math.max(...r)); const t=r[0]; r[0]=r[i]; r[i]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: Swaps the largest element with the first one.

tasks.name: ערך לא קטן ממקום
tasks.note: Keeps elements whose value minus 8 is at least their index.

tasks.name: זוגות עולים
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(let i=0;i+1<l.length;i+=2) if(l[i]<l[i+1]) r.push(l[i],l[i+1]); return r; }
tasks.note: Splits into consecutive pairs and keeps only the pairs that increase.

tasks.name: מעבר בועה מהסוף
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; for(let i=r.length-2;i>=0;i--) if(r[i]>r[i+1]){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: Runs one bubble-sort pass from right to left, carrying the smallest element to the front.

tasks.name: מחסנית מבטלת
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[]; for(const x of l){ if(s.length&&s[s.length-1]%2===x%2) s.pop(); else s.push(x); } return s; }
tasks.note: Pushes each element on a stack, but an element with the same parity as the top pops the top instead; returns the stack.

tasks.name: יוסף בדילוג
tasks.src: l=>{ const a=[...l], r=[]; let i=0; while(a.length){ i=(i+1)%a.length; r.push(a.splice(i,1)[0]); } return r; }
tasks.note: Lists elements in the order they are removed when every second one around the circle is taken out.

tasks.name: סיבוב לפי הראשון
tasks.src: l=>{ const n=l.length; if(!n) return []; const k=l[0]%n; return [...l.slice(k),...l.slice(0,k)]; }
tasks.note: Rotates left by the first element modulo the length.

tasks.name: גל
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; for(let i=0;i+1<r.length;i++) if((i%2===0)===(r[i]>r[i+1])){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; } return r; }
tasks.note: One left-to-right pass of neighbour swaps that makes the list go up, down, up, down.

tasks.name: הגדול מהקצוות
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; let i=0, j=l.length-1; while(i<=j) r.push(l[i]>=l[j]?l[i++]:l[j--]); return r; }
tasks.note: Repeatedly takes the larger of the two ends of the list.

tasks.name: הכנס את האחרון
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return [...l]; const x=l[l.length-1], r=l.slice(0,-1); let i=0; while(i<r.length&&r[i]<x) i++; return [...r.slice(0,i),x,...r.slice(i)]; }
tasks.note: Moves the last element to just before the first earlier element that is larger than it.

tasks.name: לפי גדולים אחריו
tasks.note: Sorts by how many larger elements come later, keeping the original order on ties.

tasks.name: היפוך רצים עולים
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[]; let s=0; for(let i=1;i<=l.length;i++) if(i===l.length||l[i]<l[i-1]){ r.push(...l.slice(s,i).reverse()); s=i; } return r; }
tasks.note: Reverses each maximal increasing run in place.
